opening_log: The chair is still warm. Marcos Viera's mug — chipped handle, town fair prize. His log has gaps where there shouldn't be. HQ expects business as usual.

thoughts.hq_will_notice: HQ notices reliability. That's not always a compliment.
thoughts.keep_the_book: Some truths live in the log before they live on the net.
thoughts.clean_channel: Clean channel. Their words, not yours.

first_gap.title: Log gap
first_gap.body: Marcos left a margin note about a frequency not on the posted list. HQ says routine rotation. The dates don't comfort me.

net_control.title: Net Control
net_control.body: First order: keep the channel clean. Unverified civilian bands are not my problem — until they are.

day_close: Night one. The basin hums. Marcos's handwriting is clearer than HQ's.
